label.purpose: Ops chrome: section marks, captions, skip link.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals, splash, and state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Copper pill CTA for the main conversion action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-block; cursor:pointer; background:var(--accent,#B87333); color:var(--ink,#070A11); font-family:var(--font-inter),system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.0625rem; font-weight:600; border:1px solid var(--accent,#B87333); border-radius:999px; padding:1rem 2rem; transition:background .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,transform .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-soft,#E3AC6C); border-color:var(--accent-soft,#E3AC6C); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--fg,#F2EFEA); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost pill for secondary navigation or alternate CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-block; cursor:pointer; background:transparent; color:var(--fg,#F2EFEA); font-family:var(--font-inter),system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.0625rem; font-weight:500; border:1px solid rgb(184 115 51 / 0.35); border-radius:999px; padding:1rem 2rem; transition:border-color .2s ease,color .2s ease,background .2s ease,transform .2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--accent-soft,#E3AC6C); color:var(--accent-soft,#E3AC6C); background:rgb(184 115 51 / 0.08); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--fg,#F2EFEA); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Frosted panel for offers, forms, and intake steps.
components.html:
Diagnostic

Cartographier les processus et prioriser selon l'impact.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel,#080C15) 88%, transparent); border:1px solid var(--line,rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); border-radius:1.5rem; padding:1.75rem; color:var(--fg,#F2EFEA); } .ds-glass-title { margin:0 0 .75rem; font-family:var(--font-playfair),Georgia,serif; font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3.5vw,2.125rem); font-weight:400; } .ds-glass-body { margin:0; font-family:var(--font-inter),system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.0625rem; line-height:1.72; color:var(--muted,#98A1B3); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Ops index opener with copper mark, muted label, and hairline rule.
components.css: .ds-section-label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.875rem; margin-bottom:2rem; } .ds-section-index { font-family:var(--font-jetbrains),ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:.8125rem; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent,#B87333); } .ds-section-name { font-family:var(--font-jetbrains),ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:.8125rem; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted-2,#778093); } .ds-section-rule { flex:1; height:1px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.10); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Dark field with copper-soft focus ring for intake and partner forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.5rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family:var(--font-jetbrains),ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:.75rem; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted-2,#778093); } .ds-input { width:100%; background:var(--panel,#080C15); color:var(--fg,#F2EFEA); border:1px solid var(--line,rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); border-radius:.75rem; padding:.85rem 1rem; font-family:var(--font-inter),system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.0625rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-soft,#E3AC6C); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Surface Accent
components.description: Quiet copper signal bar for callouts without filling the panel.
components.html: <aside class="ds-surface-accent">Déployé chez vous. Écouter, diagnostiquer, décider, exécuter, mesurer.</aside>
components.css: .ds-surface-accent { background:rgb(184 115 51 / 0.08); border-left:2px solid var(--accent,#B87333); padding:1rem 1.25rem; color:var(--fg,#F2EFEA); font-family:var(--font-inter),system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.9375rem; line-height:1.72; }

narrative.overview:
The interface reads as a forward-deployed command surface: dark night field, copper mandate accent, editorial display type for the claim, and mono labels for the operational layer. It should feel classy and premium without luxury theatrics — quiet authority for a DG deciding to book a briefing.

Density stays deliberate. Sections breathe, hero claims sit large in Playfair, supporting copy stays Inter, and section chrome / CTAs lean JetBrains Mono. Depth is tonal and glassy, not shadowed furniture.
keyCharacteristics: Default theme Bronze (#B87333 on #070A11); alternate themes exist for A/B but Bronze is signature.
Pill CTAs, glass/hairline panels, uppercase mono section marks (§ 01).
Operational dryness: quasi-flat surfaces, minimal hover lift (-1px), no decorative shadow stacks.
Motion: short ease-out rises and reveals; honor prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Copper Rarity Rule
rules.body: Copper is the mandate color, not a wash. Prefer accent on CTAs, labels, and thin signals — not large filled backgrounds.

rules.name: The Theme Switch Rule
rules.body: Live theme swaps remap the same semantic tokens. New work must use semantic vars, never hard-code Bronze hex outside the theme table.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif owns the claim; sans owns the explanation; mono owns the instrument panel.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat at rest. Do not introduce multi-layer drop shadows or neon glows to fake premium.

rules.name: The Pill Mandate Rule
rules.body: Primary actions are pills. Do not square off CTAs or invent a second primary shape language.

dos: Do speak in semantic tokens (--bg, --fg, --accent, --panel, --line, --muted*) so theme switching stays valid.
Do keep copper rare and CTA-led; measure success against booked briefing clarity.
Do pair Playfair claims with Inter body and JetBrains labels.
Do use glass + hairline for panels, pills for actions.
donts: Don't invent purple/indigo SaaS gradients, cream+terracotta brochure looks, or broadsheet dense columns as the default world.
Don't add multi-layer shadows, glow stacks, or bounce/elastic easing.
Don't wrap everything in nested cards; cards are for interaction or clear panel grouping only.
Don't hard-code Bronze hex in components when a semantic token exists.
Don't invent testimonials, logos, or pricing visuals the product does not have.
